meta.description: Infrastructure level breakpoints, names, and core modifiers for Epochs of Ascendancy. Used by InfrastructureDevelopmentManager and Province getters.

1.name: Dirt Tracks & Trails
1.description: Pre-industrial movement. Heavy attrition and slow supply.

3.name: Gravel & Improved Local Roads
3.description: Basic motor transport possible. Still vulnerable to weather and interdiction.

6.name: Light Rail & Paved Roads
6.description: First real strategic mobility. Enables meaningful armored and motorized operations.

9.name: Standard Rail Network
9.description: Backbone of 20th-century industrial warfare. High throughput and rapid reinforcement.

12.name: Heavy Rail + Early Motorways
12.description: Supports dense mechanized formations and rapid theater-wide redeployment.

15.name: Integrated Transport Grid
15.description: Modern combined-arms logistics. Extremely high resilience to interdiction.

20.name: Network-Centric Logistics
20.description: Late 20th / early 21st century standard. Real-time tracking and hardened routes.

25.name: Autonomous & High-Speed Grid
25.description: Near-future hardened infrastructure. Massive surge capacity and drone/automation support.
